messages:
Maya: Tiny ask: on a 15-min commute — recommend 5 short stories (<5k words) and 3 songs under 4 min. Bonus for weird/strange mood. Go!
Devon: 'The Tell-Tale Heart' (Poe) — classic bite-sized psych. Also 'Harrison Bergeron' (Vonnegut) if you want bleak satire.
Rita: For uncanny: 'The Yellow Wallpaper' (Gilman) hits like a freight train and reads fast. For microfiction try SmokeLong or Every Day Fiction.
Omar: Modern weird + short: 'Sea Oak' (George Saunders) — funny and creepy, ~10-12 mins if you read slowly. If you want <5 min, check online zines like One Story.
Ethan: Songs (all ~3-4 min): 'Motion Sickness' — Phoebe Bridgers (3:54), 'Breezeblocks' — alt-J (3:47), 'Extra Fresh' — Birocratic (3:12) for a lo-fi instrumental.
Maya: Poll time: react with :books: for Poe, :spiral_notepad: for Gilman, :alien: for Saunders.
Devon: :books:
Rita: :spiral_notepad:
Omar: :alien:
read-bot: Saved thread picks to the #reading-list channel and a shared doc: https://docs.google.com/example — editable by anyone. Reminder set for Friday book-share.
Maya: Also — any microfiction (<200 words) recs for a coffee break?
Rita: Hemingway's six-word story is dumbly perfect: "For sale: baby shoes, never worn." Also check 'Flash Fiction Online' for single-page hits.
Ethan: If you like instrumental loops, 'Birocratic - Extra Fresh' and 'Idealism - both of Us' are good short lo-fi staples.
Omar: I'll build a 15-min playlist from these and post the link in the doc. Collab open if you want to add tracks.
Maya: Sweet. Starting with Poe tomorrow morning — will report back if the train becomes dramatic. :joy:
